# costgraph_integrations (Data Source)

List integration connections in the tenant bound to the configured API key. Returns common metadata without credentials, sorted by connection UUID. An empty tenant returns an empty list. The API returns the complete tenant list without pagination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "costgraph_integrations" "current" {}

output "integration_ids" {
  value = [for integration in data.costgraph_integrations.current.integrations : integration.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the tenant bound to the configured API key.
- `integrations` (Attributes List) Tenant integration connections sorted by their internal UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--integrations))

<a id="nestedatt--integrations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `integrations`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (String) Public connection identifier.
- `display_name` (String) Connection name shown in CostGraph.
- `id` (String) Internal connection UUID used for management.
- `ingest_mode` (String) How the connection collects or uses data, such as push, pull, or telemetry.
- `provider_account_id` (String) Provider billing account identifier.
- `provider_name` (String) Canonical provider name.
- `status` (String) Connection status reported by CostGraph.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant that owns the connection.
